rule.statement: The learned High Court judge erred in deciding the case on preliminary issues 14 and 16, as the pleadings recede to the background once issues are framed.
rule.supporting_quote: once issues are framed the pleadings recede to the background (Hanafi v. Nallamma 1998 (1) SLR 73) and irrespective of the pleadings the judge is expected to decide on the case as crystallised in the issues.
